provenance_notes.source: Conaty 2011 MPhil thesis (Trinity College Dublin), inputs/FINAL_thom_conaty.pdf
provenance_notes.room_table: Table 4.3.1.1, thesis printed page 31 (figure on printed p.31, PDF page index 41); values verified from the native-resolution embedded table image.
provenance_notes.room_names: From the panel titles of Figure 4.3.1.1 (floor plans reproduced from Lindau et al. 2010), thesis printed p.31.
provenance_notes.room_footprints: Digitized from Figure 4.3.1.1 floor plan outlines, calibrated on the 0 and 20 m axis labels; about plus minus 0.5 m. Heights derived as V/(length*width). The thesis itself never tabulates per room dimensions.
provenance_notes.tmp50_samples: Digitized from Figure 6.2 (printed p.46) blue x markers; x positions matched to Table 6.1b detected samples; y read via tick-calibrated axes. Reconciled values additionally constrained by the four reported regressions (figure annotation coefficients).
provenance_notes.tmp50_ms_fig432: Digitized from Figure 4.3.2 (printed p.33) error bar mean dot; CI limits from serif caps.

method_constants_2011.hmw_window_note: HMW.m passes y=50 but MATLAB k(i:(i+y)) is 51 samples inclusive
method_constants_2011.smooth_note: MATLAB smooth() is a centred moving average and reduces even spans to the next lower odd span
method_constants_2011.detection_rule: first i >= 1000 with profile(i) >= threshold (FDthres.m, Appendix 9.1.1)
method_constants_2011.tail_slice: x((length-round(length/10)):length), i.e. the last 10 percent plus one sample
method_constants_2011.criteria_thresholds: I: tail mean; II: mean - 1 SD; III: mean - 2 SD; IV: mean - 3 SD

ism.algorithm: Allen and Berkley 1979 image source method, MATLAB port of the Fortran appendix (sroom.m)
ism.source_xyz_text: x = L/2, y = 2, z = 1.9 (thesis printed p.39)
ism.receiver_xyz_text: x = L/2, y = 1, z = 1.9 (thesis printed p.39)
ism.gui_screenshot_discrepancy: Figure 5.1a GUI shows source (5, 1, 1.9) and receiver (5, 2, 1.9) for a 10x10x10 example, i.e. y swapped vs the text. RIR is reciprocal under the swap.
ism.beta_from_alpha: conversion formula NOT stated in thesis; beta = sqrt(1 - alpha_ave) is the standard Allen-Berkley convention, unverified
ism.rir_length_s: UNCERTAIN. GUI default 0.256 s; Figure 5.1b plots Room 1 RIR to 0.2 s; Figure 5.3 Room 1 FD profile extends to about 17200 samples which is about RT*fs (0.39 s). Per-room length never stated.
